lines: Naina tum hi bure ho, tum se bura na koi
couplets.en: Eyes, there is no one crueller than you.

lines: Aap hi preet ki aag lagaye, aap hi baitha roye
couplets.en: You kindle love's fire yourself, then sit and weep.

lines: Kisi ka kya jo qadmon par jabeen-e-bandagi rakh di
couplets.en: What is it to anyone if I bowed at those feet?

lines: Hamari cheez thi, hum ne jahan jaani wahan rakh di
couplets.en: It was mine to lay wherever I saw fit.

lines: Jo dil manga to woh bole, thehro yaad karne do
couplets.en: When I asked for my heart, you told me to wait while you tried to remember.

lines: Zara si cheez thi, hum ne Khuda jaane kahan rakh di
couplets.en: It was such a little thing, and God knows where I put it.

lines: Jab se tune mujhe deewana bana rakha hai
couplets.en: Ever since you left me mad with love.

lines: Sang har shakhs ne hathon mein utha rakha hai
couplets.en: Everyone has a stone in hand.

lines: Uske dil par bhi kari ishq mein guzri hogi
couplets.en: Love must have been hard on that heart, too.

lines: Phoolon se zakhm khaye hain
couplets.en: It was flowers that wounded me.

lines: To kaanton se kya gila
couplets.en: What grievance could I have against the thorns?

lines: Naam jis ne bhi mohabbat ka saza rakha hai

lines: Kajal darun kirkira, surma saha na jaye
couplets.en: Even kohl feels like grit these eyes can scarcely bear.

lines: Jin nainan mein pi base, dooja kaun samaye
couplets.en: When my beloved lives in these eyes, who else could find room?

lines: Pattharo, aaj mere sar pe baraste kyun ho
couplets.en: Stones, why do you rain down on me today?

lines: Yeh duniya bari bawari, patthar poojne jaye
couplets.en: This foolish world goes out to worship stones.
